sentence.description: One English fill-in-the-blank sentence appropriate for the requested CEFR level, containing exactly one ________ placeholder for the target word.

options.description: Exactly three distinct single-word English options that could plausibly complete the sentence.

correctAnswer.description: The requested target word exactly as provided; it must appear in options.

explanation.description: a one-sentence explanation in the learner's native language, it can explain the meaning of the word and/or the context in which it is used.
